description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableThing that implements the Thing interface, representing a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes various properties such as thingId, acl, policyId, definition, attributes, features, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and metadata, along with methods to manipulate these properties and serialize the object to JSON.

classes.name: ImmutableThing
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Thing interface representing a 'Thing' in the model, with properties such as ID, ACL, policy, definition, attributes, features, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and metadata. Provides methods for property access, modification, JSON serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the revision of the Thing.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the last modification timestamp.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the creation timestamp.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the Thing lifecycle state indicates deletion.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ThingId.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the namespace part of the ThingId.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the given Attributes set.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Returns a new instance with Attributes removed.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute at the given JSON pointer.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specific attribute at the given JSON pointer.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ThingDefinition.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition of the Thing using a definition identifier.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition from the Thing.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Features.

methods.name: removeFeatures
methods.description: Removes the Features from the Thing.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets the Features to the provided Features object.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Adds or replaces a Feature identified by its featureId.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a Feature identified by featureId.

methods.name: setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition for a specific feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition of a specific feature.

methods.name: setFeatureProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a specific feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperties
methods.description: Removes properties from a specific feature.

methods.name: setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property of a feature identified by featureId.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property from a feature.

methods.name: getAccessControlList
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the access control list.

methods.name: setAccessControlList
methods.description: Sets a new access control list.

methods.name: setAclEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates an ACL entry.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions for the specified authorization subject.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the PolicyId.

methods.name: setPolicyId
methods.description: Sets the PolicyId for the Thing.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ThingLifecycle state.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle state.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Metadata.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Thing into a JsonObject based on the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on the properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
